sequence: T1-weighted (3D anatomical, defaced by the dataset)

source.title: Balloon Analog Risk-taking Task (OpenNeuro ds000001 v1.0.0), sub-01/anat/sub-01_T1w.nii.gz
source.author: Tom Schonberg, Christopher Trepel, Craig Fox, Russell A. Poldrack
source.license: CC0 1.0 (Public Domain Dedication; the dataset README also cites ODC PDDL 1.0)

modifications: Four axial slices (voxel indices 98, 103, 108, 113 of 192 along the superior axis, about 6.7 mm apart) taken from one volume reoriented to RAS; resampled to isotropic pixels, cropped and centred on a 512x512 canvas; contrast clipped at the 99.7th percentile and a mild gamma applied; the background outside the head (residual defacing artefacts) set to black; converted to grayscale WebP. No anatomical content added or removed.
